en: A black‑and‑white landscape image showing rows of an orange (citrus) orchard in the foreground with many ripe fruits on the trees. Beyond the orchard rises a dramatic, rugged mountain range with steep, textured slopes. The composition emphasizes the contrast between cultivated groves and high mountains. A thin white border frames the image, and faint reversed text appears along the top edge, as on printed photographic postcards.
